The MasterTech™ 052 Autosampler 
The MasterTech 052 Autosampler provides assurance that samples are prepared and analyzed exactly the same way, every time. The MasterTech is designed to increase throughput, repeatability, and reproducibility while reducing operator involvement. Up to 18 samples can be queued to run sequentially and completely unattended, including automatic stirring or sonication prior to transfer to the analysis system. The SediGraph’s operating software controls the MasterTech, and information about dispersion is stored in the sample file for future reference.
The MasterTech features a powerful ultrasonic probe for sample redispersion. Power to the probe tip is adjustable and the driving circuit is self-tuning for maintaining efficient and consistent sonic energy levels. A front-panel digital readout lets you know when the desired power is reached, and that same power is applied each time the method is repeated. The SediGraph III Plus is designed to accommodate the MasterTech on top of the analytical unit, thus conserving valuable bench space.
